आश्चर्य 1. आश्चर्य, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. चर् with
आ, with a sibilant inserted), appearing rarely, curious,
marvellous, astonishing, wonderful, extraordinary;
(अम्), ind. rarely, wonderfully; (अम्), n. strange ap-
pearance; a wonder, miracle, marvel, prodigy; won-
der, surprise; astonishment.
—आश्चर्य-ता, f. or आश्-
चर्य-त्व, अम्, n. wonderfulness, wonder, astonish-
ment.
—आश्चर्य-भूत, अस्, आ, अम्, having a mar-
vellous appearance, wonderful.
—आश्चर्य-मय, अस्,
ई, अम्, wonderful, marvellous, miraculous.

2. आश्चर्य, nom. P. (?) -यति, -यितुम्, to be won-
derful.
